item.title: Do Macro Variables Help Forecast the Yield Curve? Three Honest Experiments
item.description: A follow-up to the yield-curve forecasting post. I add inflation, the repo rate, the rand and the VIX to the forecasts in three ways - lagged, forecasted, and with perfect foresight - to find out whether macro data actually helps. It does, but only if you can see the future.

item.title: Forecasting South African Government Bond Yields
item.description: I raced about twenty forecasting models against each other on SA government bond yield buckets, and the humble random walk turned out to be really difficult to beat. The only thing that reliably helps is averaging two simple models. Sophistication is not the same thing as accuracy.

item.title: ML-Driven TFSA ETF Portfolio Optimization for EE
item.description: I built a LightGBM pipeline to pick ETFs for my EE TFSA and it beats the JSE Top 40 by 6–9% annualised. Over-engineered retirement planning? Guilty.

item.title: Balance Sheet Optimisation Under South African Regulatory Constraints
item.description: A worked Linear Programming example for the bank treasury function using SARB Basel III requirements (LCR, NSFR, CET1). Includes full LP formulation, step-by-step Simplex solution, shadow price interpretation, and how the solver works mathematically. No actual treasury departments were harmed in the making of this post, though a few may feel personally attacked.
